Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface ParameterGroup

public interface ParameterGroup
One generation-bound folder in the Editor parameter hierarchy.

Relationship lists contain opaque IDs in provider-reported order. Optional label-color access and editing require a provider with verified Editor authoring support; returned colors are detached immutable values.
